verdict.rationale: Browserbase provides event-driven building blocks: webhooks that POST to your endpoint when subscribed events occur, managed from Settings or the SDK with signature verification, plus scheduled agent runs and a `pauseWhen` condition that pauses a run on a defined trigger. The rule-to-action logic itself has to be built in your own endpoint code, because no native rules engine is documented. Missing for 10: a native rule/condition builder that maps events to actions, documented event types for triggering agent runs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
